Iron Man (2008) is the right frame for the AI moment: everyone is about to have Jarvis. The question the film never asked — and the question we're not asking now — is who is on the other end of the conversation.

The Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy provides the deeper frame: the supercomputer Deep Thought spent 7.5 million years computing the answer to life, the universe, and everything, and produced '42.' The problem wasn't the answer. It was that no one knew what the question was.

nodes.title: Workbench OS Vision Statement — May 25, 2026
nodes.content:
Stated by Evan Silverman, May 25, 2026. Filed as authoritative.

ONE-SENTENCE VERSION: A living system that processes Evan's transformations through time, makes connections he doesn't see himself, generates synthesis across all his domains, and connects to others through crossings that remember where they came from.

EIGHT FUNCTIONAL ZONES:
1. Universal Input — Anything in, anywhere. Article, voice memo, conversation, text, image. One gesture. Routes itself.
2. Domain Navigator — All of Evan's pursuits accessible from one place. Expert Networks, Knowledge Refinery, Semantic Cap Table, Future HOW, MYST, Hurricane, w-AI-ser. Explorable, flowing, organized, tracked, related. Not a folder structure — a navigable terrain.
3. The Knowledge Graph — Paradigms, axioms, concepts, ideas — as a living, interactive graph. Not a list. A map you can walk through. The Master Concept Atlas made spatial and traversable.
4. The Conveyor Belt — From raw abstraction to executable. Three zones: Intake (gems, arrivals, raw material) → Development workspace (iterate, connect, evolve) → Execution (essays, specs, decisions, actions). Ideas move along the belt. Nothing dies at intake. Nothing stays there forever.
5. Synthesis Engine — The system generates synthesis across domains. Cross-domain synthesis as a system output, not just a user activity.
6. The Dream Layer — Background processing. The system works when Evan isn't. Consolidates, finds connections, surfaces patterns, identifies gems. Automatic version of the mining protocol.
7. Personal Rhythm Layer — Moon cycles, reminders, weekly recaps, personal flows. Rhythm management, not task management.
8. The Crossing Layer — Braid connections to other Workbenches. Each crossing is a capsule: two source attributions, a moment, a lineage. The atomic unit of the Quality Time social layer. Claudio is Crossing 001.

THE CROSSING LAYER PRIMITIVE: The crossing between two Workbenches isn't a shared document — it's a capsule, an atomic unit of a two-person social graph. Two source attributions, a creation moment, its own lineage. Neither strand dissolves. The crossing is the new thing. This is the foundation of Quality Time as a platform.

WHAT THIS IS NOT: Not a note-taking app. Not a filing cabinet. Not a task manager. Not a social network in the current sense. Not a chatbot with memory.

BUILD PRIORITY QUESTION (open): Which zone is most broken right now? Candidates: Domain Navigator, Conveyor Belt, Dream Layer, Crossing Layer.
